whatsapp.label: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.title: AI agent for WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.description: An AI agent that answers your WhatsApp Business around the clock, qualifies every lead and respects the 24 hour window with approved templates. For small businesses in Argentina and Latin America.
whatsapp.heading: An AI agent that answers your WhatsApp Business around the clock
whatsapp.lead: WhatsApp messages arrive at any hour and whoever answers first usually makes the sale. BoxLead connects your number through Meta's official API and puts an agent on every chat.
whatsapp.capabilitiesHeading: What BoxLead does with your WhatsApp

capabilities.title: Your number, in a single inbox
capabilities.description: Chats from your WhatsApp Business number reach BoxLead along with your other channels, and every reply goes out from that same number.

capabilities.title: 24 hour window and templates
capabilities.description: Once 24 hours have passed since the person's last message, BoxLead offers your approved templates to keep the conversation going.

capabilities.title: Official Meta connection
capabilities.description: You connect with Facebook login and WhatsApp Business embedded signup. No virtual numbers or third-party apps on your phone.

steps.title: Log in with Facebook
steps.description: Pick your WhatsApp Business number from Meta's embedded signup.

steps.title: Chats reach the inbox
steps.description: Every message that number receives shows up in BoxLead with its contact.

steps.title: Set up your agent
steps.description: Tell it what you sell and how you serve customers, and choose whether it replies on its own or leaves drafts.

faqs.question: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer: BoxLead uses Meta's official WhatsApp Business API. You connect from BoxLead with your Facebook account and your number, with no technical setup on your side.

faqs.question: What happens after 24 hours?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp closes free-form text 24 hours after the person's last message. BoxLead lets you know and offers one of your approved templates to reply.

faqs.question: Does it work with Instagram and MercadoLibre at the same time?
faqs.answer: Yes. The same inbox brings together WhatsApp, [Instagram](/instagram), [Messenger](/messenger) and [MercadoLibre](/mercadolibre), and the same agent can handle all of them.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.title: Answer Instagram messages and comments with AI
instagram.description: An AI agent that answers direct messages and comments on your Instagram posts and reels, brings each person into one conversation and qualifies your leads.
instagram.heading: Instagram direct messages and comments, answered by your agent
instagram.lead: Instagram questions come in by DM and in the comments. BoxLead brings them into one conversation per person and puts an agent to answer with your business information.
instagram.capabilitiesHeading: What BoxLead does with your Instagram

capabilities.title: Direct messages and comments together
capabilities.description: Direct messages and comments on posts and reels land in each person's conversation, with a link to the post.

capabilities.title: Public or private reply
capabilities.description: Reply to the comment publicly or by direct message from the same screen. If DMs are already closed, it goes out as a private reply to their last comment.

capabilities.title: Official Meta access
capabilities.description: You authorize BoxLead from your Instagram professional account with Meta's official access.

steps.title: Authorize your professional account
steps.description: From BoxLead, with Instagram's official access.

steps.title: Everything lands in one conversation
steps.description: Direct messages and comments, per person and with their history.

steps.title: Set up your agent
steps.description: Add your products, prices and tone, and choose how much to hand off.

faqs.question: Does it answer comments or only direct messages?
faqs.answer: Both. Comments on posts and reels show up in the person's conversation and can be answered publicly, and direct messages are answered privately.

faqs.question: Do I need a professional account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Instagram only lets you connect professional accounts, business or creator, with Meta's official access.

faqs.question: What if the person never sent me a DM?
faqs.answer: You can answer publicly on their comment. If Instagram no longer accepts direct messages for that person, BoxLead sends the reply as a private reply to their last comment.

messenger.label: Messenger
messenger.title: AI agent for Messenger and your Facebook Page
messenger.description: An AI agent that handles the messages your Facebook Page receives on Messenger, replies on behalf of the Page and keeps every lead organized in your inbox.
messenger.heading: Messages to your Facebook Page, answered automatically
messenger.lead: Every message that reaches your Page on Messenger is a question waiting for an answer. BoxLead brings them to your inbox and puts an agent to reply on behalf of the Page.
messenger.capabilitiesHeading: What BoxLead does with your Page

capabilities.title: Your Page messages in your inbox
capabilities.description: Messages your Page receives reach BoxLead as leads, and replies go out on behalf of the Page.

capabilities.title: 24 hour window
capabilities.description: Messenger lets you reply within 24 hours of the person's last message. BoxLead tells you when that window has closed.

capabilities.title: Several Pages, one inbox
capabilities.description: You can connect more than one Page and see them next to WhatsApp, Instagram and MercadoLibre.

steps.title: Log in with Facebook
steps.description: Pick the Page you want to connect.

steps.title: Messages reach the inbox
steps.description: Every Page conversation shows up with its history.

steps.title: Set up your agent
steps.description: Tell it what you sell and how you serve customers, and choose how much to hand off.

faqs.question: Does it work for my business's Facebook Page?
faqs.answer: Yes. BoxLead connects to Facebook Pages and handles the messages they receive on Messenger.

faqs.question: Can I connect the Page and the Instagram account of the same business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each channel connects separately and they all land in the same inbox. See how it works with [Instagram](/instagram).

faqs.question: What if more than 24 hours have passed?
faqs.answer: Messenger only lets you reply within 24 hours of the person's last message. You'll be able to write back when they message your Page again.

mercadolibre.label: MercadoLibre
mercadolibre.title: Answer MercadoLibre questions automatically with AI
mercadolibre.description: An AI agent that answers questions on your MercadoLibre listings and the post-sale messages of every order, with your business information and within minutes.
mercadolibre.heading: MercadoLibre questions and post-sale messages, answered right away
mercadolibre.lead: On MercadoLibre an unanswered question is a sale that goes to another listing. BoxLead brings questions and order messages into one inbox and puts an agent to answer them.
mercadolibre.capabilitiesHeading: What BoxLead does with your MercadoLibre account

capabilities.title: Questions on your listings
capabilities.description: Every new question reaches the inbox with the listing it belongs to, and the answer is published on MercadoLibre.

capabilities.title: Post-sale with the order context
capabilities.description: Messages from each order arrive with the order status, and the buyer's contact details are saved on the lead.

capabilities.title: Within MercadoLibre's rules
capabilities.description: One answer per question, up to 2000 characters, and post-sale messages up to 350. BoxLead warns you before something can't be sent.

steps.title: Authorize your seller account
steps.description: From BoxLead, with MercadoLibre's official access.

steps.title: Questions and orders in the inbox
steps.description: Every question and every post-sale message shows up with its context.

steps.title: Set up your agent
steps.description: Add your catalog, your shipping and payment terms, and choose how much to hand off.

faqs.question: Does it only answer questions or post-sale messages too?
faqs.answer: Both. Questions on your listings and messages from each order land in the same inbox and the agent can handle both stages.

faqs.question: Can I review the answer before it's published?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can leave the agent in draft mode and approve every answer before it goes out to MercadoLibre.

faqs.question: What if the question was already answered?
faqs.answer: MercadoLibre allows a single answer per question. BoxLead answers the oldest pending question and tells you when there are none left open.

agencias.label: Agencies and community managers
agencias.title: BoxLead for agencies and community managers
agencias.description: Add an AI agent to every client you manage. Connect their WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and MercadoLibre channels, set the tone and show results without adding support hours.
agencias.heading: Add an AI agent to every client you manage
agencias.lead: Your clients' customers don't wait for your office hours. BoxLead lets you build one agent per client that answers with that business's information.

capabilities.title: One account per client
capabilities.description: Each business has its own inbox, its connected channels and its agents, with that client's information and tone.

capabilities.title: No-code setup
capabilities.description: You add products, prices, FAQs and tone in a form, and choose whether each agent replies on its own or leaves drafts.

capabilities.title: The four channels your clients use
capabilities.description: WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Messenger and MercadoLibre with each platform's official access.

steps.title: Connect the client's channels
steps.description: With their own accounts and Meta's and MercadoLibre's official access.

steps.title: Build the agent
steps.description: Name, instructions, tone and the business information.

steps.title: Show results
steps.description: The metrics page sums up what was answered, how fast and which leads were qualified.

faqs.question: Do you have an agency program?
faqs.answer: Yes. Write to us at [support@boxlead.app](mailto:support@boxlead.app) and we'll tell you how to work with BoxLead for several clients.

faqs.question: Does the client see the inbox or only me?
faqs.answer: Each account belongs to the business. Anyone with access to that account sees its inbox, leads and metrics, and you can work together with your client.

faqs.question: Can I review what the agent replies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each agent can work automatically or leave drafts for a person to approve before sending.
